overview: This enum chooses whose battle-log values a condition checks.

None.simple: No fighter is selected, so the condition cannot pass.
None.technical: EvaluateLog has no case for None, so its character list stays empty and it returns false before SumLogValues runs. Exported MissionTask and BattleTalkSet rows use None as padding in unused target slots.

Ally.simple: The condition checks the player and their allies on the same team.
Ally.technical: EvaluateLog calls GetTeamCharacters with the player's GAISlot001 team and adds every returned character index. SumLogValues then aggregates the selected log values over those characters.

Myself.simple: The condition checks only the player's fighter.
Myself.technical: EvaluateLog adds only the player character index to its candidate list. Ranking-record reward checks also pass Myself directly to EvaluateLog with bTotal set to true.

Enemy.simple: The condition checks the rival team.
Enemy.technical: EvaluateLog calls GetTeamCharacters with the player's rival team and adds every returned character index. The resulting values are aggregated across that team.

Invalid.simple: This value marks an invalid target selection.
Invalid.technical: The enum declares it with value 255. No exported target slot uses it and no named consumer reads it. It would fall through EvaluateLog to the same empty list as other unhandled values.

notes: MissionTask and BattleTalkSet read TargetType at the same index as ValueType and pass it to EvaluateLog.
SumLogValues adds selected values across characters. It uses the maximum for CursedEnergy_Level and the mean for HitPointRate.
EvaluateLog returns false when the player pointer is invalid or the selected character list is empty.
None is the padding value in exported target arrays and leaves a condition unable to pass.
